items.title: Button Sounds – collection of professionally-recorded button clicks and presses

explainer.summary: Button Sounds is a free collection of recorded button clicks and presses for use in user interfaces, made by developer Josh W. Comeau.
explainer.why_now: It was posted to Hacker News, where commenters praised the polish and discussed pitch, iOS audio limits and requests such as toggle switch sounds.
background: According to the Hacker News thread, the sounds were recorded in a sound-treated room with a Zoom H4 and cleaned up in Adobe Audition, while the synth sounds were made digitally. All are stereo.
Commenters noted that iOS Safari blocks audio until the user interacts and that the silent-mode switch also mutes it. One said some variants sound about a semitone off.
